editorial.blurb: A top-tier takeout destination serving flavourful Nepalese momos and noodles at unbeatable prices, with freshly made everything and a nice variety of sauces.
editorial.insiderTip: Order a combo bowl (chicken curry with momos for around $11) and grab it to-go—the steamed momos are consistently fresh and the thin, chewy noodles with veggies are worth the trip.
